Amendment 03: See atttached Amendment 03 Q&A for responses to all remaining solicitation questions.  

 Amendment 02: See atttached Amendment 02 Q&A for responses to intial solicitation questions received. An additional  amendment Q&A will follow with responses to additional questions that are still pending responses. 

 Amendment 01: The response due date has been extended from November 5, 2026 to November 23, 2026.  

 The National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Center for Neutron Research (NCNR) owns and operates a 20 MW test reactor called the National Bureau of Standards Reactor (NBSR) located in Gaithersburg, Maryland. The NBSR is fueled by 30 highly enriched uranium fuel elements. During the course of a year, the NBSR produces approximately 28 spent fuel elements. To be in accordance with the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC), NIST is required to transfer its spent fuel to the Department of Energy (DOE) Savannah River Site (SRS) near Aiken, South Carolina. 

 This requirement is for one base shipment to be completed no later than December 31, 2028, with an option for a second shipment to be completed no later than December 31, 2030. See attached solicitation# 1333ND27QNB610AMD and related attachments for full details.
